data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions 5,651 (248) 5,403
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 169.218m. During 2024 the Syndicate recorded a gross strengthening of prior year provisions of GBP 5.651m (approximately 3.34% of opening gross reserves). The annual reserve movement is disclosed in the technical provisions reconciliation and the Syndicate cites economic inflation, social inflation/litigation trends and climate-related considerations as factors taken into account when setting reserving assumptions. The report does not attribute the prior year strengthening to any single named event or specific underwriting year.
raw_causal_phrases: Management has considered the effects of the continued heightened inflation environment on claims reserves and has made appropriate allowance in the reserve results.
Specific considerations were made around current economic circumstances, social inflation trends and the potential impact to business portfolio mix when setting reserving assumptions.

HMA and the Syndicate are also mindful that there is a risk that climate change may adversely affect reserving requirements and monitors its climate-related exposure closely, assessing current and future climate change risk in a variety of ways, including stress and scenario testing, over short and long term time horizons.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement (GBP 5,651k) sourced from the 'Claims outstanding' technical provisions reconciliation line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross). No standalone explanatory sentence quantifying the gross prior year movement was present - the table row has been quoted verbatim. No breakdown of the prior year movement by line of business is provided in the report, so LOB-level amounts are not available.
